White MBA Class of 1957 Senior Lecturer of Business Administration MBA Class of 1957 Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Bob White is a Senior Lecturer in the Entrepreneurial Management Unit at the Harvard Business School where he teaches courses in the MBA program (Required and Elective curricula) and the Executive Education program. Courses taught include Entrepreneurial Finance, Starting a Private Investment Firm, Road to the White House, Elections and Campaigns, Elections and Democracy, and Field Global Immersion.
